purpose: Rank active research lanes by the shortest evidence path to a defensible executable threshold. This is not a probability of profit, jackpot prediction, or permission to wager.

priority.name: Betfair España — AP McCoy Sporting Legends Daily overdue first-bet
priority.whyClosest: Betfair and Playtech publish the following-day first-bet rule; the provider variant is bound to tonymc, sljp-1 protocol semantics and guaranteedHitTime/winc timestamps are parsed, and a fail-closed GREEN contract plus non-Poisson prospective empirical race bound are implemented. In an exact overdue state, normal random jackpot hazard is no longer the decisive uncertainty; the remaining economic gate is the first-eligible-bet race.

one-sided Clopper-Pearson prospective race lower-bound engine implemented without requiring Poisson stationarity

jackpotReality.targetCapability: Detect a verified positive-EV entry state, specify exact game/stake/budget/validity window, and accept stochastic realization except where a published overdue first-bet rule makes the next eligible network bet deterministic and only the race-to-submit remains uncertain.
jackpotReality.greenCanOccurTodayIf: A candidate closes its missing evidence gates and the fresh live state is simultaneously inside the resulting verified entry region.
